proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ _ _ A B C
  have h1 : ((A ∪ B ∪ C).card : ℝ) + ((A ∪ B) ∩ C).card = (A ∪ B).card + C.card := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_union_add_card_inter (A ∪ B) C
  have h2 : ((A ∪ B).card : ℝ) + (A ∩ B).card = A.card + B.card := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_union_add_card_inter A B
  have h3 : (((C ∩ A) ∪ (B ∩ C)).card : ℝ) + ((C ∩ A) ∩ (B ∩ C)).card = (C ∩ A).card + (B ∩ C).card := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_union_add_card_inter (C ∩ A) (B ∩ C)
  have e1 : (A ∪ B) ∩ C = (C ∩ A) ∪ (B ∩ C) := by
    ext x; simp only [Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_union]; tauto
  have e2 : (C ∩ A) ∩ (B ∩ C) = A ∩ B ∩ C := by
    ext x; simp only [Finset.mem_inter]; tauto
  rw [e1] at h1
  rw [e2] at h3
  rw [← add_div, ← add_div, ← sub_div, ← sub_div, ← sub_div, ← add_div]
  congr 1
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (A B C : Finset Ω), ((A ∪ B ∪ C).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω = (A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω + (B.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω + (C.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω - ((A ∩ B).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω - ((B ∩ C).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω - ((C ∩ A).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω + ((A ∩ B ∩ C).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω
